end.parentNote: Asha practised triangular numbers by arranging 1+2+3 dots and square numbers by adding a row and column. Ishita explained the square-number growth method across several examples; when counting the new row and column, they first omitted the shared corner, then corrected it by counting 4+4+1. They became tired with repeated questions, so at home, try one short picture-sequence question and ask Ishita to explain the added row, column, and corner.
